The '''Thakwaa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thakwaa/Legends|Thakwaa]].
